questions.q: Which tropical modernism work is by Geoffrey Bawa?
questions.ref: General references on tropical architecture and climate-responsive design
questions.n: Kandalama in Sri Lanka melts into the cliff and jungle, so the hotel seems grown, not built.

questions.q: Which architect said, 'In all my works, light is an important controlling factor'?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Ando is the master of concrete and light, such as the Church of the Light.

questions.q: Which bond guarantees that the contractor will complete the work as contracted?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: Word root: bond from Old English bindan, 'to bind'. The contractor is bound to deliver.

questions.q: A light, insulated, light-colored, well-ventilated house suits which climate?
questions.ref: General references on tropical architecture and climate-responsive design
questions.n: Humid heat needs moving air, not stored heat. Think of a breezy stilt house. The recall stem was cut off.

questions.q: Which Frank Lloyd Wright work is the only skyscraper he built, nicknamed 'the tree that escaped the forest'?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Price Tower in Oklahoma has a central 'trunk' with floors branching like limbs.

questions.q: Under the amended BP 344, how far from the entrance may an accessible elevator be located at most?
questions.ref: 2024 Amended IRR of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: 30 m is the maximum walk to the elevator. Larger transport facilities use respite areas instead.

questions.q: Which author wrote 'The Image of the City'?
questions.ref: General urban-planning history (Kevin Lynch, Hippodamus, Ebenezer Howard, Vitruvius)
questions.n: Lynch studied how people mentally map a city, as if each person carried a sketch in their head.

questions.q: Which museum is the most visited in the world?
questions.ref: General references on landmark buildings and records
questions.n: The Louvre draws around 9-10 million visitors a year, helped by the glass pyramid entrance.

questions.q: Which parking slot size is for a truck or bus?
questions.ref: Philippine laws and standards (PD 705, PD 1185, PD 223, PD 957, BP 220)
questions.n: A bus needs both width and length. The recall key lists 3.6 x 12; confirm against your IRR table.

questions.q: Which Roman author and architect wrote 'De architectura', the famous ten books on architecture?
questions.ref: General urban-planning history (Kevin Lynch, Hippodamus, Ebenezer Howard, Vitruvius)
questions.n: He is the Roman theorist of architecture and city planning.

questions.q: Which concert hall is celebrated for its exterior, interior, and acoustics together?
questions.ref: General references on landmark buildings and records
questions.n: The recall had a question mark here. Disney Hall (Gehry) is known for its steel curves and strong acoustics, while Sydney is better known for its shells than its sound.

questions.q: What does CPD stand for?
questions.ref: General Philippine architectural practice terms
questions.n: CPD means architects keep learning to renew their license, like updating an app.

questions.q: What does DADS stand for, and what share of the DAEDS fee does the architect receive?
o: Direct Architect Design Service; 100% of the DAEDS fee
Detailed Architectural Design Services; 40% of the DAEDS fee
Design And Drafting Services; 25% of the DAEDS fee
Detailed Architectural Design Services; 60% of the DAEDS fee
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: Architect-only gets 60% because the architect leads and coordinates but other designers do the rest.

questions.q: Which Egyptian tomb is usually the main building of a complex surrounded by an enclosure wall?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Roman building
questions.n: The pyramid sits in a courtyard of temples and walls. A ziggurat is Mesopotamian, not Egyptian.

questions.q: Who is the architect of the Quezon Memorial Shrine?
questions.ref: General references on Filipino architecture; National Artists and notable Filipino architects
questions.n: Ilustre designed the three-pylon shrine in Quezon City. The tall pylons rise like three candles around the tomb.

questions.q: What percentage of the design fee is paid for the contract documents phase?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: This phase is the heavy work: drawings, specs, and contract papers. Schedule: 5, 15, 15, 50, then 15 for construction.

questions.q: Greek temple architecture grew from which kind of belief?
o: Belief centered on life after death
Gods tied to nature (anthropomorphic nature deities)
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Roman building
questions.n: Egypt's belief in life after death shaped its tombs; Greece honored gods of sky, sea, and harvest. The recall key listed 'natural' for this one.

questions.q: Who founded the architecture firm Morphosis?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Word root: Morphosis comes from Greek morphe, 'form', so 'the shaping of form'. Mayne won the Pritzker Prize in 2005.

questions.q: What is the minimum percentage of gross rentals for post-construction services?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: Range is 4% to 6%: the low end is 4%.

questions.q: Which cathedral is a famous pilgrimage site, housing the Virgin's veil and renowned for its stained glass?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on French Gothic cathedrals and the Renaissance
questions.n: Pilgrims came to Chartres for centuries. Word root: pilgrim from Latin peregrinus, 'foreigner, traveler'.

questions.q: Who said 'Form follows function'?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Sullivan's idea: shape should come from purpose, like a spoon's bowl comes from holding soup.

questions.q: What do you call the architect who performs post-construction services on site?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: 'Resident' means one who stays there, like a building's live-in architect. The recall key says resident architect.

questions.q: Which is a passive (non-mechanical) way to cool a tropical building?
questions.ref: General references on tropical architecture and climate-responsive design
questions.n: Passive means no machine does the cooling. The recall's choices were Solar Control Glass, Insulation, and Mechanical, and its key leaned toward insulation.

questions.q: Which architect designed the Yale University Art Gallery and is known for beginning his significant building career around age 50?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Kahn bloomed late, like a tree that fruits after many years.

questions.q: Which compensation method bases the fee on revenue or profitability outcomes of the project?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: You are paid for results, not hours. Think of a sales commission.

questions.q: Thick, light-colored walls suit which climate?
questions.ref: General references on tropical architecture and climate-responsive design
questions.n: Thick walls store the day's heat and release it at night, and light color reflects sun, like a clay water jar that keeps water cool. The recall stem was cut off.

questions.q: Which architect developed the theory called Biorealism, linking design to human biology and nature?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Word root: bio = life, so 'design that respects living people'. Neutra is also tied to the recalled 'razor-sharp sense of individuality' quote.

questions.q: Under the amended BP 344, what is the minimum width of sidewalks, walkways, and pathways?
questions.ref: 2024 Amended IRR of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: 1500 mm lets a wheelchair user and a walker pass each other. The older IRR used 1200 mm, so always read 'as per amended BP 344'.

questions.q: Which describes Japanese architecture?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Straight lines, clean planes, and simple spaces, like a folded sheet of paper.

questions.q: Which is the largest aquarium in the Southwestern United States, a 200,000 sq ft facility in Scottsdale?
questions.ref: General references on landmark buildings and records
questions.n: The recall stem said 'in the world', but OdySea is the largest in the Southwest, so know both phrasings. Aquariums are Exceptional-group buildings in the fee schedule (they need consultants).

questions.q: What is the minimum frontage of a regular lot under PD 957 (open-market subdivisions)?
questions.ref: Philippine laws and standards (PD 705, PD 1185, PD 223, PD 957, BP 220)
questions.n: Open-market lots are bigger than socialized lots: 10 m versus 8 m. The recall key lists 10 m.

questions.q: Who is regarded as the father of urban planning, known for the gridiron plan?
questions.ref: General urban-planning history (Kevin Lynch, Hippodamus, Ebenezer Howard, Vitruvius)
questions.n: He laid streets in a grid, like graph paper for cities.

questions.q: Which Manhattan building has 70 floors?
questions.ref: General references on landmark buildings and records
questions.n: Empire State has 102 floors and the Chrysler 77. Rockefeller is the 70-floor one.

questions.q: What does OCT stand for in land titling?
questions.ref: General Philippine architectural practice terms
questions.n: An OCT is issued the first time land is registered. Word root: the Torrens system is named after Sir Robert Torrens.

questions.q: What does DAEDS stand for?
o: Direct Architect and Engineer Daily Services
Detailed Architectural and Engineering Design Services
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: DAEDS is the complete design package: architecture plus engineering. It is the more common arrangement.

questions.q: Which tomb of the nobility is cut into a cliff, with a portico in front and an offering chapel behind?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Roman building
questions.n: Hewn means chiseled out of rock, like carving a cave room from a cliff.

questions.q: Which Filipino architect is known for passive cooling design and specialty hospitals?
questions.ref: General references on Filipino architecture; National Artists and notable Filipino architects
questions.n: Ramos is the name tied to climate-wise hospital design. Memory trick: Ramos = hospital + natural cooling.

questions.q: What percentage is paid upon signing the agreement under regular design services?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: Signing is the smallest payment, like a deposit.

questions.q: Which ancient architecture is known for using concrete along with brick, terra cotta, and marble facing?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Roman building
questions.n: Roman concrete let them build arches, vaults, and domes. Marble was a thin skin over brick and concrete.

questions.q: Which architect is known for vernacular, native-inspired design?
questions.ref: General references on Filipino architecture; National Artists and notable Filipino architects
questions.n: Think of him as the architect who made the bahay kubo a luxury resort.

questions.q: What is the fee range for post-construction services when based on gross rentals?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: Post-construction covers building administration and maintenance. Another option is a fixed monthly salary.

questions.q: Which cathedral has a west facade with three deep, richly carved portals?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on French Gothic cathedrals and the Renaissance
questions.n: Amiens is huge and its three doors welcome you like a triple gate. The key comes from the recall.

questions.q: Who said 'Less is more'?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Mies means strip away everything unnecessary, like a clean sentence with no extra words.

questions.q: For post-construction services, which compensation modes are available?
o: Fixed monthly salary or a percentage of gross rentals
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: A resident architect can be on salary or paid by a cut of the building's rental income.

questions.q: Which is considered the most important building of the Renaissance?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on French Gothic cathedrals and the Renaissance
questions.n: It gathers the work of Bramante, Michelangelo, and Bernini and was the Renaissance's grandest project.

questions.q: Which architect is part of the New York Five and also associated with the Memphis Group?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: The New York Five were Eisenman, Graves, Gwathmey, Hejduk, and Meier. Graves also designed playful Memphis-style objects.

questions.q: Which mode of compensation fits an ocular inspection?
o: Lump sum for the whole building
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: A visit is short and open-ended, so pay for the time. Per diem comes from Latin per diem, 'by the day'.

questions.q: Which set of traditional materials is typical of tropical architecture?
questions.ref: General references on tropical architecture and climate-responsive design
questions.n: Local, natural, breathable materials suit the heat. The recall had two versions; this is the natural-materials one.

questions.q: Which architect said architecture should appeal to the human heart while also being logical?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Tange blended Japanese tradition with modern structure, as in the Yoyogi National Gymnasium. Quote attribution is from the recall key.

questions.q: Which decree is the Revised Forestry Code of the Philippines?
questions.ref: Philippine laws and standards (PD 705, PD 1185, PD 223, PD 957, BP 220)
questions.n: PD 1096 is the Building Code, PD 1185 the Fire Code, and PD 223 created the PRC.

questions.q: Which window placement is appropriate in Metro Manila given the sun path?
o: Unshaded glass on the west wall
questions.ref: General references on tropical architecture and climate-responsive design
questions.n: East and west windows catch low, hot sun. A north clerestory brings steady daylight with little heat. The recall's options were cut off.

questions.q: Which architect designed the Johnson Wax Headquarters?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: Its mushroom-like columns are a Wright signature.

questions.q: What is the minimum frontage of a regular lot under BP 220 (socialized housing)?
questions.ref: Philippine laws and standards (PD 705, PD 1185, PD 223, PD 957, BP 220)
questions.n: BP 220 allows smaller lots to keep housing affordable. The recall key lists 8 m.

questions.q: Which set lists the five elements of the city image?
questions.ref: General urban-planning history (Kevin Lynch, Hippodamus, Ebenezer Howard, Vitruvius)
questions.n: Path = a route; edge = a boundary; district = a zone; node = a junction (Latin nodus, 'knot'); landmark = a point you remember.

questions.q: Which is the tallest building in the world?
questions.ref: General references on landmark buildings and records
questions.n: The Burj Khalifa is about 828 m tall. Shanghai Tower is second-tier in height.

questions.q: Which parking slot size is for a jeepney or shuttle?
questions.ref: Philippine laws and standards (PD 705, PD 1185, PD 223, PD 957, BP 220)
questions.n: A jeepney is smaller than a bus. The recall key lists 3 x 9; confirm against your IRR table.

questions.q: Who proposed the Garden City concept?
questions.ref: General urban-planning history (Kevin Lynch, Hippodamus, Ebenezer Howard, Vitruvius)
questions.n: A garden city blends town and country, like a city wrapped in a green belt.

questions.q: Which Egyptian tomb type was for nobles and officials: a flat-roofed rectangular structure with sloping sides?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Roman building
questions.n: Word root: Arabic mastaba, 'bench', because it looks like a low bench. Pyramids came from stacking mastabas.

questions.q: Who designed the Church of the Risen Lord in UP Diliman, known for its saddle-shaped hyperbolic paraboloid roof?
questions.ref: General references on Filipino architecture; National Artists and notable Filipino architects
questions.n: Concio designed this Protestant chapel in the 1950s. Word root: hyperbolic comes from Greek hyperbole, 'a throwing beyond', and paraboloid from parabole, 'a placing alongside'. Think of a Pringles chip: curved up one way and down the other.

questions.q: What is the DAEDS rate for a mall complex (Group II, moderate)?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: Group I is 5%, Group II is 6%, Group III is 7%, and residences are 10%. Memory trick: 5, 6, 7 going up in complexity.

questions.q: Greek architecture used which set of materials?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Roman building
questions.n: Greece had marble and limestone quarries. No concrete: that is the Roman trick.

questions.q: Which architect designed the Pearl Farm Beach Resort in Davao?
questions.ref: General references on Filipino architecture; National Artists and notable Filipino architects
questions.n: Mañosa is the Filipino vernacular master, known for the 'Tropical Filipino' style with bamboo, thatch, and native forms.

questions.q: Architect, staff, and consultant fees count as which kind of cost in compensation computations?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: They are direct personnel expenses, the people who actually do the work.

questions.q: Which French Gothic cathedral had the loftiest (highest) vault, which later collapsed?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on French Gothic cathedrals and the Renaissance
questions.n: Beauvais aimed for the sky and fell, like a tower of blocks stacked one too high. Word root: Gothic was a Renaissance insult after the Goths.

questions.q: Which work is by Louis Sullivan?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: The Wainwright Building in St. Louis is an early steel-frame skyscraper. Sullivan's famous line is 'form follows function'.

questions.q: What is the maximum percentage of gross rentals for post-construction services?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: Range is 4% to 6%: the top is 6%.

questions.q: Which cathedral is known as the coronation church of French kings?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on French Gothic cathedrals and the Renaissance
questions.n: Kings were crowned in Reims, so it is the royal ceremony hall.

questions.q: Which architect said 'A house is a machine for living in'?
questions.ref: General architectural-history references on modern and contemporary architects
questions.n: A machine is efficient and plain, so Le Corbusier wanted houses to be the same.

questions.q: Annual gross rentals are P20,000,000. Using the 4% to 6% range, what is the post-construction fee range?
questions.ref: UAP Doc 202 (Design Services), schedule of minimum basic fees (DAEDS/DADS) and payment schedule; UAP Doc 205 (Post-Construction Services)
questions.n: The recall noted 3 to 4 computation questions on this, with 20M and 15M as examples. For P15M the range is P600,000 to P900,000.
